Key materials developed and translated as practice guidance to achieve sustainability of all the training provided in the course of this Project and to facilitate the induction of new staff and the continuing professional development of existing staff. An electronic library is currently being established to ensure availability of best European and International practices for all practitioners managers and policy makers operating in the area of social protection in Jordan. This will into the future support the work of the virtual social work research and training centre currently being developed within MoSD.
